subject: Provisioning tracebacks and SSO/SCIM evidence for SIG review
messages:
From: Emily Rivers <emily.rivers@scyllahealth.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: security@scyllahealth.com
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: SCY-Req: Provisioning tracebacks + SSO/SCIM artifacts for SIG

Hi Jordan,

Thanks again for taking the time on today's call. Our SOC and SIG review team has a follow-on ask: can Redwood provide a reproducible set of provisioning tracebacks for a small window (Aug 10–18) that show SAML assertion samples, SCIM delta batches, role mapping snapshots and any delegated-admin/auditor events?

Specifically we need:
- 3 redacted SAML assertion samples (include the full assertion headers but redact PII)
- SCIM delta export for a 24-hour period (CSV or JSON) showing create/update/delete ops
- Role mapping snapshot for the tenant (who maps to which RBAC role ids)
- Delegated admin audit log subset showing when elevated roles were granted/revoked
- A short README describing where logs were collected and any redaction rules applied

Can you confirm you can deliver these artifacts and an estimated ETA? Our compliance window for SIG review is the week of Aug 24. If you can point us to a secure share (or upload to the Drive link from the questionnaire), that would be ideal.

Appreciate it — we can also hop on a quick 20-min call if any of the items are unclear.

Thanks,
Emily Rivers
Security Programs | Scylla Health
security@scyllahealth.com

--
Attachment: SIG-questionnaire.pdf (pdf stub)

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Emily Rivers <emily.rivers@scyllahealth.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 17:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SCY-Req: Provisioning tracebacks + SSO/SCIM artifacts for SIG

Hi Emily — thanks for the clear list. We can provide the artifacts you outlined. High level plan and constraints below: 

Plan:
- We will collect redacted SAML assertions (3 samples) and package them into a zip.
- SCIM delta export for a 24h window: CSV with timestamps and operation type.
- Role mapping snapshot: JSON export of role_id -> members + a human-readable mapping.
- Delegated admin audit: trimmed log file with grant/revoke events and actor ids.
- README that documents redaction patterns and processing steps.

Constraints/Notes:
- We will remove PII (emails replaced by hashed placeholders) but keep name/id mappings where needed for role correlation.
- Service account events may be partially anonymized; if you need raw service-account identifiers we will need a mutual NDA addendum — let me know.

ETA:
- IRENE and CAMILA will work the artifact pulls today/tomorrow. I expect an upload to a secure Drive folder by end of day Monday, Aug 24. If anything changes I will escalate.

Upload plan:
- We will upload to a Redacted Drive share and post the link here. Files will be named with timestamps and an index.

Next steps:
- Irene: can you confirm you can pull the SCIM deltas and the delegated-admin audit subset?
- Camila: can you export the role mapping snapshot and SAML samples (redacted)?

If useful, I'm happy to set up a 30-minute walkthrough with your reviewers once we upload.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Director, Solutions Engineering
Redwood Inference

--
Attachment: none

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 21 Aug 2026 09:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SCY-Req: Provisioning tracebacks + SSO/SCIM artifacts for SIG

Thanks Jordan — acknowledging. Quick status update from infra: 

- SCIM delta export: we can extract deltas from the provisioning service for any 24-hour window. I will pull Aug 12 UTC 00:00–Aug 12 UTC 23:59 to match Emily's requested sample window. Format: CSV with columns (timestamp, op_type, user_id, external_id, attributes_changed).
- Delegated admin audit: we have a filtered audit table for role grants; I will produce a text export with actor_id, target_id, role_id, action, timestamp. We will redact email addresses to hashed placeholders.
- Retention note: the full audit table contains more context; I'll include a summarizing note in the README describing fields we omitted for privacy.

I'll start pulls today and will drop artifacts in the drive folder Jordan creates.

Irene
Sr. Platform Engineer, Redwood Inference

--
Attachment: none

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Emily Rivers <emily.rivers@scyllahealth.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 11:48:00 -07:00
Subject: Delivery: SCY SIG artifacts (redacted) — drive link + index

Emily — we uploaded the requested artifacts to a secure folder. Summary below and a link to the bundle: 

Drive link: https://drive.redwood.example.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c
Index of delivered files:
- readme_artifact_index.md (describes redaction & collection process)
- redacted_saml_assertions_20260820.zip (3 assertion files: sa1.xml, sa2.xml, sa3.xml; PII redacted)
- scim_delta_sample_20260812.csv (24h delta export)
- role_mapping_snapshot_20260819.json (role->member mapping)
- delegated_admin_audit_20260812.txt (filtered grant/revoke events)

Notes & caveats:
- We hashed email addresses and removed any free-text comments from the audit lines.
- Service account events are present but use hashed ids. If you require original service-account identifiers we will need a short escalation/narrow NDA.
- If the review team needs additional time windows or more assertion samples, we can produce them; it will add ~1 business day per extra window.

Would you like a 30-minute walkthrough of the artifacts this week (Wed/Thu afternoons PST)? Happy to walk the SIG reviewers through the traceability mappings.

Jordan
Director, Solutions Engineering
Redwood Inference

--
Attachment: readme_artifact_index.md (markdown stub)

From: Emily Rivers <emily.rivers@scyllahealth.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: security@scyllahealth.com
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 15:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Delivery: SCY SIG artifacts (redacted) — drive link + index

Jordan — received, thanks to you and the infra team. I spot-checked the readme and the role mapping snapshot; looks good for our initial SIG pass. A quick ask: could you also include one additional sample showing a service-account provisioning event (create + role assignment) with the same redaction we used for user events? That sample helps our auditor validate machine identities.

If you can add that by EOD Wednesday, Aug 26, we'll be able to keep the SIG review on schedule. Otherwise we'll reach out to schedule the walkthrough next week.

Emily
Security Programs | Scylla Health

--
